sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Registration

FACT_ID: sec15-R01 | anchor: A01
Licenses come only by mail, while address moves must reach DMV within thirty days since mail will not forward them [A01].
Why it matters: group mail-clock; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec15-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec15-R02 | anchor: A01
Newcomers owe licenses in sixty days but plates in thirty, front and rear with decals [A01].
Why it matters: group newcomer-clocks; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec15-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec15-R03 | anchor: A01
The card rides along every drive, while locality registration rides only where cities demand [A01].
Why it matters: group card-locality; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec15-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec15-R04 | anchor: A01
The state inspects yearly with stickers, while drivers inspect tires monthly starting with the penny pinch [A01].
Why it matters: group inspect-tires; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec15-F04, sec15-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec15-R05 | anchor: A02
Tread passes when it swallows Lincoln's head, while pressure passes against the manual or jamb PSI [A02].
Why it matters: group tread-pressure; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec15-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-R06 | anchor: A02
Liability or five hundred dollars buys registration, but only insurance buys coverage while the fee buys a one-year pass [A02].
Why it matters: group cover-fee; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec15-F07, sec15-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-R07 | anchor: A02
Pre-2022 policies floor at twenty-five, fifty, twenty, while post-2022 floors rise to thirty, sixty, twenty [A02].
Why it matters: group minimums; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec15-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-R08 | anchor: A02
Dropping coverage starts with surrendering plates, while getting caught bare starts a six-hundred-dollar and three-year certificate climb [A02].
Why it matters: group cancel-caught; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec15-F08, sec15-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-R09 | anchor: A02
Voting wants citizenship, residency, and eighteen by election day, while donation binds at eighteen and bows to parents below [A02].
Why it matters: group civic-ages; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec15-F10, sec15-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]
